file_reviews.assessment: Audited Section 5 cemetery persistence, Section 6 hash-chaining verification, and Section 7 clonal selection and central tolerance.

Audited rows P6-06 (temporary-path full file replacement), P6-07 (internal canonical JSON scope), P6-08 (caller-supplied refusal evidence custody), and P6-09 (detector regex refusal and kill condition).
Audited CemeterySink._write_file temporary-path replacement, _canonical_json_bytes float rejection, and record_refusal parameter custody.
Audited ClonalSelectionEngine.check_kill_condition regex error interception emitting KillConditionRefusal and self-panel match emitting KillConditionReceipt.
Verified the distinct source identities recorded for the audit baseline and the later encoder observation.

claims.statement: CemeterySink._write_file writes the serialized file to a temporary path and replaces the target.
dependencies: Filesystem replace operation os.replace with atomicity dependent on underlying filesystem.
claims.limits: Confirms full-file write staging to temporary path and replacement; atomicity depends on operating system filesystem rename semantics without explicit fsync.

claims.statement: The historical sink uses sorted JSON without establishing RFC 8785 conformance. The publication receipt separately identifies a later encoder revision.
dependencies: Paper 006 Section 4 and its first-publication source bindings.
claims.limits: The retained receipt supports provenance. Tests of the present encoder exercise a different revision and do not replay the historical serializer.

claims.statement: Cochain and refusal fields are stored as supplied, not computed by the sink.
dependencies: Record refusal intake signature and pass-through normalization in pfp/infrastructure/persistence/cemetery_sink.py.
claims.limits: Storage custody does not establish semantic truth of the recorded refusal reason or mathematical validity of the cochain projection.

claims.statement: An invalid detector regex yields a typed refusal; a benign-panel match yields a kill-condition record.
dependencies: Clonal selection engine check_kill_condition in pfp/domain/immune/clonal_selection.py.
Native ThymusGate screen parity in code/rust/core_epistemic_immune_system/src/thymus.rs (lineage NATIVE-EIS-001).
claims.limits: The added tests exercise Python clonal selection. NATIVE-EIS-001 supplies separate partial evidence for the native screening path.

file_review_pins: sha256 records the original inventory bytes. Where checkout line endings differ, git_blob_sha256 records the unchanged text as stored at source_commit.
